card.name: Verb after 'more likely to' in allergy warnings
card.fires_on: The word 'occur' in 'These reactions are more likely (or apt) to occur in individuals with a history of...' in beta-lactam hypersensitivity warnings. Also 'be' after 'should' in preparation instructions.
